title: Telemetry replay safety harness with ghost-event detection and soft-run scheduling
creator: Aisha Coleman
description: Build a reusable safety harness and scheduler for large-scale telemetry replays that detects and mitigates 'ghost' or duplicate-derived events, performs dry-run cost projections, and provides tenant-scoped soft-runs before committing to production backfills.
background: We routinely run tenant-scoped backfills (replays and reprocesses) against usage analytics. Recent incidents show edge cases where deduplication gaps cause high-volume duplicate events ("ghosts") to inflate metrics and billing. Current tooling lacks a standard preflight that simulates downstream effects, estimates cost, and quarantines suspicious event batches. This work aims to provide a developer- and operator-friendly harness to reduce blast radius for future retro-ingests.
goals: Provide a dry-run mode that replays events through our analytics pipeline without mutating production state
Detect and flag ghost/duplicate event patterns using heuristics and a lightweight provenance check
Expose tenant-level cost projections for a proposed backfill window before execution
Enable a configurable soft-run schedule: small-volume safety passes that progressively increase to full backfill
Produce human-readable run reports and machine-readable artifacts for automation (run manifests, resume tokens)
scope: A harness service that accepts replay manifests and returns dry-run results
Ghost-event detection heuristics (time-window dedupe, idempotency-key checks, ordinal-shift detection)
Soft-run scheduler with adjustable plateau and guardrails (quota per tenant, max duplicates per batch)
Quarantine and quarantine-reporting UI hooks (console links) and webhook alerts
Cost estimator that uses observed token/ingest rates and current throughput pricing
out_of_scope: Retrofitting the full reconciliation engine (this will integrate with, not replace, reconcile)
Long-term cold-storage reingestion tooling — focus is on console analytics pipeline only
Changes to tenant billing model or pricing tiers
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run mode ingests a replay manifest and returns a non-mutating result matching production pipeline transforms within 2% variance on key metrics
Ghost detection flags >90% of synthetic duplicate scenarios from benchmark harness and <1% false positive rate on production-like samples
Soft-run schedule can be configured per-tenant and supports automatic ramp-up, pause, and rollback triggers
Cost estimator returns 3-line summary (estimated tokens, estimated compute-minutes, estimated cost) and a confidence range
Run report links to a resume token and a quarantined-batch log in Console; operations can abort or promote a run from the Console
tasks: Spike: implement minimal dry-run path that routes to analytics transforms without persisting output (2025-02-13)
Prototype ghost-event heuristics and unit tests (2025-02-16)
Build soft-run scheduler with tenant quotas and ramp policy (2025-02-19)
Integrate cost estimator that samples historical rates and applies current pricing (2025-02-21)
Add run-reporting and Console hooks; document Webhook schema (2025-02-24)
E2E test against staging telemetry with injected ghost scenarios; runload test (2025-02-25)
PR, security review, and deployment runbook (2025-02-26)
progress_updates: 2025-02-13: Spike complete — implemented non-persistent dry-run routing; validated transforms match production for sample payloads.
2025-02-16: Ghost detection prototype uses idempotency-key fingerprint + sliding-window ordinal check; initial false-positive rate ~3% on sampled staging data.
2025-02-18: Soft-run scheduler skeleton implemented; supports tenant windowing and quota enforcement. Started unit tests for ramp/rollback triggers.
2025-02-22: Cost estimator integrated with historical-sampler; estimator currently uses conservative upper percentile. Awaiting feedback from Finance on pricing delta.
2025-02-24: Console hooks added — run manifests and run-report link stored in staging Console. Quarantine logs surface via dedicated Console panel.

2025-02-26: E2E staging run with synthetic ghost injection completed. Observed duplicate amplification scenario surfaced an edge case; added a secondary provenance check to reduce false positives. Preparing PRs.
risks: False positives in ghost detection could unnecessarily block legitimate backfills
Underestimating cost could lead to unexpectedly high billing during promotion runs
Dry-run may not perfectly mirror production side-effects (transform nondeterminism increases variance)
Tenant isolation bugs could cause cross-tenant contamination if resume tokens are mis-scoped
mitigations: Ship detection heuristics behind a feature flag and provide manual override for trusted tenants
Conservative cost estimator by default and an ops-only promotion path if estimator confidence is low
Record transform fingerprints during production runs and compare against dry-run fingerprints to measure nondeterminism
Enforce strict resume-token namespace and add integration tests that simulate multi-tenant replay concurrency
notes: Follow-on work will add an automated canary promotion pipeline that promotes from soft-run -> full-run after metric thresholds are met
Coordinate with Finance to display cost estimates in tenant-facing run confirmation modal
Flag for an incident drill after initial prod rollout to validate rollback and quarantine workflows
